name: ownship-sentinels-decode-absent-context-fills-them
reference: Stratux commit 36b5045, makeOwnshipReport; bytes computed by tools/gen/gdl90-vectors.py. The altitude 0xFFF and the vertical velocity 0x800 decode to no key, so the context values (altitude code 60 = 500 ft, vertical velocity -3 = -192 ft/min) fill them and are written (engine-spec 0.9 ruling 6)
